description: Transfers reviewed, payments queried, new accounts turned into multi-week processes with extra documents. Individually minor, cumulatively a permanent surcharge on ordinary financial life.
money_note: Annual, in fees, spreads and delay.

aspect: Credit builds slower or not at all
description: Restricted products and refused cards mean a thinner file, which means a worse mortgage a decade later - a six-figure difference produced by an origin field.
energy_note: A worse mortgage for a worse birthplace.

aspect: And there is nothing to appeal
description: A closure or refusal letter gives no reason, because giving one may constitute tipping off. There is no accusation to rebut and every subsequent institution sees the closed account.
energy_note: Declined, permanently, with no charge stated.

description: A 2024 FinCEN comment from the National Iranian American Council documented Bank of America identifying as many as 15,000 accounts connected to individuals of Iranian heritage that had been restricted, and described the problem as systemic across the sector. The same de-risking logic is applied to Palestinian-origin customers, which is why this row sits in both datasets.
energy_note: Fifteen thousand accounts, one bank, one heritage.
